name: Elvis Njau
title: Cybersecurity Engineer
availability: Open to remote and on-site SOC analyst roles
summary: Results-driven cybersecurity engineer focused on blue-team defense, alert investigation, threat hunting, incident response, and detection engineering. I combine hands-on security labs with years of cybersecurity experience.
objective: I am looking for a SOC analyst opportunity where I can investigate alerts, analyze endpoint and network telemetry, document incidents clearly, and help improve practical detection coverage.
aboutSenior: I design and improve security capabilities across infrastructure, endpoints, networks, applications, and cloud environments, combining hands-on engineering with investigation leadership, risk-based decisions, automation, and clear technical direction.

careerTarget.summary: I am seeking a senior cybersecurity engineering opportunity where I can design resilient security controls, improve detection and response capabilities, guide technical investigations, and reduce risk across infrastructure, endpoints, networks, applications, and cloud environments.
priorities: Security architecture, network segmentation, and control design
SIEM and detection engineering across endpoint, server, network, and cloud telemetry
Incident response, threat hunting, DFIR, and investigation leadership
Vulnerability management, system hardening, and security control validation
Security automation, playbook development, technical mentoring, and continuous improvement

skillGroups.title: Security Operations
skillGroups.description: SOC workflows, alert triage, incident classification, false-positive reduction, IOC correlation, Cyber Kill Chain analysis, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

skillGroups.title: Network & Detection
skillGroups.description: Packet analysis, IDS/IPS rule authoring, wireless assessment, MITM detection, and investigation of suspicious network activity.

skillGroups.title: Endpoint & DFIR
skillGroups.description: Endpoint monitoring, forensic collection, disk and memory analysis, malware triage, response playbooks, and evidence preservation.

skillGroups.title: Application Security
skillGroups.description: OWASP-aligned web, API, and Android testing across authorization, authentication, injection, transport, storage, and client-side controls.

skillGroups.title: Reconnaissance
skillGroups.description: Passive and active discovery for target profiling, subdomain enumeration, DNS analysis, and attack-surface mapping.

skillGroups.title: Automation & SOAR
skillGroups.description: Security scripts, log parsing, IOC detection, API integrations, alert enrichment, ticketing pipelines, and repeatable analyst workflows.

skillGroups.title: Cloud & GRC
skillGroups.description: AWS security reviews, IAM and S3 misconfiguration analysis, CloudTrail review, risk assessment, policies, and framework-based gap analysis.

skillGroups.title: Adversary Simulation
skillGroups.description: Controlled Windows and Active Directory exercises, privilege escalation, post-exploitation, and detection validation in authorized labs.

details: Designed and deployed an automated threat-detection and network-visibility pipeline inside a multi-segment virtualized environment; integrated pfSense with Zeek and Snort to capture deep-packet telemetry and network intrusion indicators.
Engineered log-forwarding and ingestion pipelines from Windows Server, Linux endpoints, and network appliances into centralized Wazuh and Splunk monitoring platforms.
Authored custom detection rules, correlated endpoint and network events, and tuned false positives to improve the fidelity and usability of security operations workflows.
Built repeatable investigation and incident-triage playbooks, strengthening analyst consistency and accelerating evidence collection, enrichment, classification, and escalation.
Maintained an isolated VMware and Docker security lab for adversary emulation, malware-containment testing, control validation, and safe reproduction of attack paths.
experience.impact: Unified 5 security platforms, 3 telemetry-source categories, and 2 network detection engines into one repeatable detection and triage workflow.

details: Monitored and investigated endpoint, server, and network security events; correlated indicators and documented findings using structured incident-classification and escalation workflows.
Improved security posture through firewall-rule reviews, patch management, system hardening, access-control checks, and vulnerability remediation across Windows and Linux environments.
Automated recurring monitoring, log parsing, IOC checks, and administrative tasks with Bash and PowerShell to reduce manual effort and improve response consistency.
Supported risk assessments and control reviews aligned with NIST CSF and ISO 27001 principles, translating technical observations into clear remediation actions.
experience.impact: Automated 4 recurring security workflow categories and extended control coverage across Windows, Linux, network, and governance environments.

details: Led day-to-day IT operations for a service-critical hotel environment spanning servers, network infrastructure, employee endpoints, Point of Sale, and Property Management systems.
Established secure administration practices for user access, patching, backups, endpoint configuration, firewall rules, and vendor-supported business systems.
Centralized operational monitoring and incident escalation across infrastructure and business applications, improving visibility into outages, security events, and recurring support issues.
Developed recovery procedures and support playbooks for priority systems, strengthening continuity and accelerating coordinated triage during service-impacting incidents.
Managed technology vendors, asset lifecycles, upgrades, and departmental priorities while communicating technical risk and operational impact to business leadership.
experience.impact: Directed technology operations across 5 business-critical domains and formalized 3 resilience controls: monitoring, incident escalation, and recovery playbooks.

details: Administered Windows and Linux systems, network appliances, employee workstations, and hotel business applications to maintain availability, performance, and secure access.
Implemented routine patching, account provisioning, endpoint hardening, malware protection, backup verification, and configuration controls across the environment.
Collected and reviewed system, application, and network logs to troubleshoot faults, identify suspicious activity, and provide evidence for escalated investigations.
Automated repeatable maintenance and reporting tasks with scripts and standardized checklists, improving consistency across system administration workflows.
Executed backup and recovery procedures, software deployments, hardware maintenance, and advanced user support while preserving operational continuity.
experience.impact: Supported 4 infrastructure layers and standardized 5 core administration controls across patching, identity, endpoints, backups, and configuration management.
